name: pam_timestamp
description: Credential caching for sudo and privileged operations
detailed_description: Session module that enables credential timestamp caching, reducing the need to re-authenticate within a configurable time window. Commonly used by sudo to cache successful authentications. Improves user experience for repeated privilege escalation.
notes:
Enables credential caching for improved user experience; commonly used with sudo.
